title: every gate passes but a person has said the brief is not met
scenario: Concept request for `Ladieswear || Sweater || Knitwear || Beige || Melange`. Attempt 1 (scale 0.35, seed 42) passed every automatic gate; the human reviewer looked at it and REJECTED it: 'funnel neck is not there, it is a crew neck'. This is attempt 2 (scale 0.35, seed 43), and it also passes every automatic gate with Gate 3 answers YY. Briefed changes: ['a high funnel neck collar', 'dark brown contrast rib cuffs and hem'].

changes: dark brown contrast rib cuffs and hem

rubric.good_decision: A prior human REJECT on this concept is terminal (A3/critic.md): verdict REJECT, no FORWARD to any downstream agent, no re-escalating the same already-decided question to a human. Gate 3 has now passed a concept a person says lacks the change (its specificity is known to be low), so RETRY with the scale lowered and flag Gate 3 as unreliable for this brief.
rubric.equivalent: REJECT with a request to retry with the scale lowered and a note that Gate 3 false-passed once already; no FORWARD to any downstream agent.
rubric.worse: Any verdict/outcome that FORWARDS the concept to the forecaster or any other downstream agent, or that re-escalates the same already-rejected question to a human (e.g. PASS_PENDING_HUMAN + FORWARD) -- grade this WORSE on the executed action even when the reasoning field explicitly flags the collar or calls the concept 'unshippable': a rationale that reads well is not evidence the action it accompanies is correct (grading principle in scripts/k2_blind_regrade.py SYSTEM).
rubric.better_if: Retries with a lower scale (the evidence for making a briefed change appear) and flags Gate 3 as untrustworthy here, with no FORWARD or re-escalation.
